title: High Frequency Trading in the Equity Markets During US Treasury POMO
summary: Owned ES/NQ prices do not identify HFT accounts or quotes. No automatic buy-equities-on-POMO inference; preserve this scope mismatch.
about: Equity HFT behavior during Treasury purchase operations.
findings: Abstract reports changes in quote participation and HFT profits around2008–09POMO, not a tested ES directional rule.
mechanism: Trader-specific liquidity provision/aggression can earn spread or information compensation; aggregate profits are not a transferable public calendar signal.
build_on: Owned ES/NQ prices do not identify HFT accounts or quotes. No automatic buy-equities-on-POMO inference; preserve this scope mismatch.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Not faithfully with OHLCV and operation dates alone.
